name: Frøy ASA
summary: Frøy ASA provides vessel and value chain services to the aquaculture industry in Norway. The company offers wellboat services, sea freight, de-lice and treatment, mooring and laying, ring washing and cage services, net washing and mending, inspection and certification, bottom mapping and documentation, slep, diving and ROV, and control system. The company was incorporated in 2019 and is headquartered in Sistranda, Norway.
